note: Hamilton County IA publishes no queryable zoning service. The county points to a Schneider Beacon viewer (no public zoning service found; data download requires login). Webster City, the largest city, publishes its zoning map only as Google My Maps embeds (a KML export exists, but it is a viewer-style file, not a queryable service). No ArcGIS REST zoning layer for the county or its cities was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches.
